messages.subject: Load data before execution
parts:
I have a RDS dataset that is relatively big.
I am loading it through:
myData<-readRDS("../data/statsAll48H_all.rds")

However, every time I refresh the page it load it again. Would there be a way for me to "cache" it? Such as I do not load it every time someone visit the page?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Load data before execution
parts: Load it at the top of your server.R, before your shiny server function begins. This should cause it to only be loaded once. Well, it will be reloaded if you make changes to server.R--if you don't even want that, then put it in a separate file called global.R (in the same directory as server.R).

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Load data before execution
parts:
You can put a global.R file next to an .Rmd file and it should have the same effect.

If the data gets updated once a day you could use reactiveFileReader.

myData <- reactiveFileReader(1000, NULL, "statsAll48H_all.rds", readRDS)

Then everywhere you want to access myData, use myData() instead.

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: Load data before execution
parts:
Look up the help file for & in R by typing ?`&`

The shorter one is vectorized which means it expects two vectors and it will show the result of "AND" between every pair of elements in the two vectors. The longer one has short-circuiting behaviour, which means it operates from left to right and the moment it runs into something that is FALSE, it will stop evaluating the rest of the arguments because if one of the args is false then we already know the whole statement is false.  It's a rather technical explanation, try Googling for "shortcircuit logical and"
